before.method: linker-wrapped ENOSPC injection into production fwrite/fflush, not actual disk exhaustion

after.sanitizer_scope: complete small fixture and header-only spool; no engine or codec linked

limits: The spool is created after rendering; this change avoids wasted row conversion on known insufficient space, not the preceding render.
Successful fallocate reserves only the exact RGBA8 spool extent. JPEG output, EXIF, source caches and gallery copy have separate storage needs.
On unsupported filesystems fstatvfs is only an availability snapshot; other writers can consume the space before use.
Unknown fallback space is rejected explicitly rather than treated as guaranteed capacity.
Later I/O errors remain possible and retain cleanup handling.
No shared filesystem was filled and no physical Android runtime test was performed; Android NDK build is delegated to root.
